text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear thesis against mass production in the opening and conclusion","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay maintains a consistent position and keeps returning to it so the reader always knows what it is trying to prove."},{"evidence":"Three separate body paragraphs on cost, driver carelessness, and machine failure","quality":"organized development","description":"The essay is more cleanly structured, with distinct points that build the case in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"“The amount of money that it would take…” and “one faulty driverless car…”","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It uses its evidence to explain why the negative effects matter rather than only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"“However,” “Although,” and direct responses to possible objections","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges opposing views and answers them, which makes the argument feel more deliberate and persuasive."},{"evidence":"Quote about half a million crash-free miles and the fault question","quality":"source use","description":"It draws on specific details from the article to ground its claims instead of relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"“What makes these accidents happen…carelessness” and “one faulty driverless car”","quality":"precision of claims","description":"Its language is more concrete and exact, which makes the warnings sound more credible."}]}
